I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. There's no Brackenwater contract, CRM record or renewal date in any file or channel she can see, so there's nothing to check it against.

I told her to treat 8 April as an unconfirmed lead until the account owner or the signed contract backs it up. I also offered to help her write a short question for the account owner once she knows who that is. I didn't record the date anywhere else.
